scope: Independent padded-packet physical ARQ protocol pilot; not a completed resource-equivalent paper baseline
token_packet_assignment: Use the existing preregistered per-image permutation and four-token strided packetizer; undo both mappings after reception
receiver_crc_rule: Stop each packet at first valid receiver CRC, even if sender truth would reveal a payload error. Count accepted-but-wrong payloads separately.
sender_oracle_rule: Ideal reference only: stop each packet at first payload equality with sender truth, irrespective of CRC parity status.
cap_handling: Retain last reception, flag each unaccepted packet as censored; do not silently drop capped packets or pretend guaranteed delivery.

noise.generator: NumPy PCG64; independent complex AWGN for each packet/attempt
noise.coupling: All policies share identical packet/attempt realizations; simulate union of packets still needed by either ARQ rule.

ledgers.efficiency_reporting: Record per-frame payload pixels/attempted-payload-bit and forward pixels/QAM-symbol. Any cohort ratios require explicit ratio-of-sums definition. Feedback, headers and CMI remain unmodeled.

gates: Noiseless matched framing round trip before noisy pilot
Unit fixtures for CRC false acceptance, parity-only failure, cap censoring and ledger consistency
Verify seed uniqueness and policy-order independence
Preserve attempt traces for independent stop-rule replay and integer ledger audit
No whole-cohort PER or quality means until 50 experiments per SNR; pilot reports coverage and exact accounting only
